_comment: The hosted page's OAuth client IDs (docs/web-deploy.md § Web sign-in). Public values: React's hosted build carries the same Google and Microsoft IDs. Each provider's console must list https://admin.invoicing.co (Google: an authorized JavaScript origin; Microsoft: an SPA redirect URI) before it works there. Apple stays empty until its Services ID lists admin.invoicing.co and the server's APPLE_CLIENT_IDS accepts it; an empty ID hides the button.
